sample.name: Clifton 10
sample.summary: Lightweight max-cushion neutral daily trainer with HOKA’s signature rockered geometry.
why: Clifton leans further into max-cushion meta-rocker plushness
Better when easy days need more underfoot softness than FF Blast bounce

sample.name: GEL-Kayano 32
sample.summary: Max-cushion stability shoe with 4D GUIDANCE SYSTEM for controlled daily and long-run miles.
why: Kayano adds a support-focused platform with 4D GUIDANCE SYSTEM versus Novablast’s neutral ride
Better when daily and long miles need more guidance than a soft neutral trainer

sample.name: Endorphin Speed 5
sample.summary: Nylon-plated tempo shoe for workouts, faster long runs, and accessible race efforts.
why: Endorphin Speed adds a nylon plate and quicker tempo geometry versus Novablast’s soft daily bounce
Stronger choice when workouts and faster long runs need more snap than FF BLAST MAX

sample.name: Ghost 18
sample.summary: Soft neutral daily trainer with broad width options for beginners and high-mileage road runners.
why: Ghost pairs a protective rubber outsole coverage pattern with a traditional daily upper for high-mileage wear
Often preferred when longevity under high weekly volume matters more than Novablast bounce
